info.title: Meu Preço API
info.description:
meupreco ingests Brazilian NFC-e (fiscal receipts), matches each line to a
canonical product and tracks per-unit price history across supermarkets.

Conventions:
- Every error is the canonical envelope: `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.
  A few codes (captcha challenges, rate limiting) add sibling fields.
  Unexpected server failures answer `500` with `error.code = "internal_error"`.
- Money is always transported as a decimal **string**, never a float.
- All receipt/read/admin endpoints require a bearer access token; a
  reissue pair is obtained from `/auth/login` and rotated via
  `/auth/refresh`.
- Requests are rate limited per client IP and, once authenticated, per
  user. A throttled request answers `429` with `error.code = "rate_limited"`
  and a `Retry-After` header.

servers.description: Define here your Meu Preço API instance URL, defaults to localhost:8080. This is the URL the browser will use on the "Try it out" sections

422.description: Invalid name, email or weak password (`invalid_name` / `invalid_email` / `invalid_password`)

post.summary: Authenticate and obtain an access+refresh pair
Rotate a refresh token into a new pair

401.description: Invalid/expired refresh token, or reuse detected (`invalid_refresh_token` / `refresh_reuse_detected`)

get.summary: The authenticated user (name, email, role, created_at)

post.summary: Draft a receipt (fetch + classify; nothing committed)
post.description:
Normalizes the access key (or the QR payload embedding it), fetches the
DANFE from the issuing portal and returns an itemized plan bound to a
pending preview. Re-drafting the same receipt while a pending preview
exists replays that plan (200) without a refetch. May answer `412` with
a captcha challenge that must be solved first. The preview distinguishes
lines that can be automatically saved from `uid_uncertain` lines that
need an explicit resolution during submit; no receipt or price log is
committed by this operation.

429.description: Per-client budget spent (`rate_limited`) or the fiscal portal is throttling (`upstream_rate_limited`)

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (present for `rate_limited`)

post.summary: Confirm a preview and commit it atomically
post.description:
With `confirm=false` it reports what a commit *would* write without
writing. Cross-user re-submits and already-ingested receipts are the
silent dedup path (200, `written:0`). Confirming the same `preview_id`
twice answers `409`.

Each `uid_uncertain` line with no matching entry in `resolutions`
defaults to `needs_review`: a private price log with `product_id` NULL
that an admin can resolve later. A line is written nothing and counted
under `skipped` only when `skip` is requested explicitly. `assign` links
an existing product but keeps the row pending review: an assignment
only becomes public after an explicit admin approval. Automatically
identified lines are saved as trusted observations; manually assigned
lines are proposals. Proposals remain private until approval, and
assignment, approval, and rejection are recorded in the append-only
`price_log_event` audit history.

422.description: Preview expired (`preview_expired`) or a legacy draft has no stored receipt snapshot (`preview_snapshot_missing`)

500.description: Stored receipt snapshot is corrupt or uses an unsupported schema (`preview_snapshot_unreadable`)

post.summary: Delete a receipt, its price logs and its drafts
post.description: Allowed for the user who committed the receipt or for an admin.

400.description: Malformed body or blank access key (`invalid_request` / `invalid_filter`)

403.description: Not the owner nor an admin (`forbidden`)

post.description:
A correct answer yields the pending preview the receipt was blocked on.
Wrong answers answer `412` with the remaining attempt budget; a locked
challenge `429`s; a reused one `409`s.

429.description: Challenge locked or per-IP budget spent (`challenge_locked` / `rate_limited`)

get.description: Returns only products with at least one approved, product-linked price log (`needs_review = false`). Catalog seed rows and products referenced only by pending manual assignments are hidden until an admin approves a price observation.

200.description: Result page (needs_review rows are never surfaced)

400.description: Bad pager or invalid gtin/unit filter (`invalid_filter`)

get.description: A product is public only when it has at least one approved price log. Products with no approved observation, including products referenced by pending proposals, return `404`.

get.summary: Price curve + per-unit aggregate for a product
get.description: Returns only approved price observations. The product must have at least one approved price log; pending or rejected proposals never contribute to this history and otherwise produce `404`.

get.summary: Products + latest logged price at one store

delete.summary: Delete a supermarket (admin only, guarded by receipts)

200.description: User details (never includes the password hash)

403.description: Not an admin, or self role change (`forbidden`)

get.description: Searches all existing products, including products without an approved price log and products marked `needs_review`. The filters and pagination match the public product search, but no public visibility predicate is applied. This differs from [GET /api/v1/products](/#/products/get_api_v1_products), because this endpoint fetches all products.

400.description: Bad pager or invalid gtin/unit filter (`invalid_filter`)

get.description: Every `price_logs` row with `needs_review = true`: unresolved lines (`product_id` null) and manual assignments proposed by users. For a proposal the item carries `proposed_product`, `resolved_by` and `resolution_note` so an admin can compare it with the receipt line. `proposal_status` reflects the latest price-log event: `rejected` when the latest action is `reject`, otherwise `pending`. A rejected proposal remains visible in the queue and unpublished; batch assignment creates a new pending proposal, and approval is what clears `needs_review` and publishes the row.

post.summary: Approve or reject a price-log proposal (admin)
post.description:
Applies an administrative decision to one `needs_review` price log that
has a proposed product. The decision is appended to the immutable
`price_log_event` history as `approve` or `reject`. `approve` sets
`needs_review` to false and publishes the row. `reject` retains the
proposed product, the original assigning user, and `needs_review =
true`, so the proposal remains hidden and reports `proposal_status:
rejected`. A subsequent batch assignment appends a new `assign` event
and resets the proposal to `pending`, allowing another approve or reject
decision. Repeating the same decision without an intervening assignment
returns `already_processed`; unresolved rows without a proposed product
cannot be reviewed. The authenticated admin is the event actor;
`user_id` is not accepted in the request body.

200.description: Decision recorded; returns the reviewed product

400.description: Invalid request/action or review without a proposed product (`invalid_request` / `invalid_review_action` / `bad_request`)

409.description: Price log is not in review or the latest event already records the requested decision (`already_processed`)

post.description:
Records or replaces the product proposed for each queued receipt line.
The update keeps `needs_review` true: batch assignment only changes the
pending proposal, so a rejected proposal can be reassigned. A new
assignment after a rejection resets `proposal_status` to `pending`;
publication happens through a separate approve decision. Every
successful proposal update appends an `assign` event in the same
transaction; one invalid entry rolls back the whole batch.

400.description: Invalid merge pair or malformed body (`invalid_assignment` / `invalid_request`)

patch.description: Curate the display fields. A rename recomputes `canonical_stem` and `product_key` atomically; editing only brand or unit recomputes the key while keeping the stem. A rename that collides with another product's identity returns `409 product_identity_conflict` and must be resolved by merging the duplicate or assigning the price log to the existing product.

400.description: Empty patch, malformed body or bad unit (`invalid_request` / `invalid_filter`)

409.description: The rename would collide with another product's identity (`product_identity_conflict`). Resolve it by merging the duplicate or by assigning the price log to the existing product.
Still referenced and no purge requested (`in_use`)

post.summary: Map a receipt stem to a canonical product (admin)
post.description:
Creates one `commodity_synonyms` row. `synonym` and `canonical_name`
are normalized to the parser's stem vocabulary. Set `prefix_expansion`
to register an abbreviation (e.g. `qj` -> `queijo`) that the classifier
expands before fuzzy matching. Duplicate synonyms return `conflict`.

400.description: Empty/unnormalizable synonym or canonical name, bad unit, or malformed body (`invalid_assignment` / `invalid_request`)
Invalid CNPJ pair or malformed body (`invalid_assignment` / `invalid_request`)

200.description:
Per-route request counters, latency histogram and auth-failure
counts; when OFF enrichment is enabled, `off_cache` holds the
Open Food Facts hit/miss counters.

Error.description: Canonical error envelope. Endpoints reference the per-code schemas (e.g. `InvalidRequestError`) so only the codes they can emit are advertised; this schema documents the complete envelope and the full code set.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Clients should switch on this value rather than parsing `message`. Codes such as `captcha_required` and `captcha_wrong_solution` also carry the extra fields documented by their dedicated schemas.

status.description: `ok` on success; `unavailable` on a failed readiness check.

reason.description: Present only on a `503` readiness response: why the process is not ready (e.g. "database not configured", "database unreachable").

LoginRequest.description: Authenticate with `login` (an email OR a name) and `password`. The legacy `email` field is still accepted as an alias for `login`.

status.description: Identity verdict for the line (the price_logs.identity_status CHECK set). `commodity_fingerprint` and `parse_error` are emitted by the classifier alongside `gtin_known`, `gtin_new` and `uid_uncertain`.

Resolution.description: Per-line decision for a `uid_uncertain` line. `needs_review` (the backend default when the line is omitted) persists a private row with no product; `skip` discards the line and must be requested explicitly; `assign` links an existing `product_id` and records a proposal that stays `needs_review` until an admin approves it.

action.description: Defaults to `needs_review` when a line has no resolution at all.

resolutions.description: Optional per-line resolutions for `uid_uncertain` lines. Lines left out default to `needs_review`; submit `skip` explicitly to drop one.

assigned.description: `uid_uncertain` rows resolved to an existing product via an explicit `assign` resolution. These rows are pending review: `assigned` never means publicly trusted.

needs_review.description: `uid_uncertain` rows persisted as private review rows without a product (the default for unresolved lines).

pending_review.description: Total rows written awaiting admin review (`assigned + needs_review`). Only approved rows are public.

skipped.description: Lines that wrote nothing: explicit `skip`, unparseable lines, or already-logged duplicates.

ReviewProductView.description: Product proposed by a user for a `uid_uncertain` receipt line. Only the admin review queue exposes it; public product reads never include pending proposals.

canonical_stem.description: Stored identity stem of the proposed product. May disagree with the display name; omitted when the product has no canonical stem.

proposed_product.description: Present when a user manually assigned the line: the product is a proposal pending admin review. Absent for an unresolved line.

resolved_by.description: User id that proposed the assignment (absent when unresolved).

resolution_note.description: `assign` for a manual proposal, `needs_review` for an unresolved line.

needs_review.description: Always true in the queue; approval sets it to false and publishes the row.

proposal_status.description: Current proposal state derived from the latest price-log event. `pending` when there is no event or the latest action is `assign` or `approve`; `rejected` when the latest action is `reject`. Rejected proposals remain in the queue and can be reassigned.

last_review_action.description: Latest price-log event action. Null when the price log has no review-event history.

action.description: `approve` publishes the product-linked proposal; `reject` keeps it in the private review queue and marks it rejected. Both require a proposed product.

ReviewDecisionResult.description: Product projection returned after a review decision. The authoritative record of the decision is the price-log event history.

action.description:
`existing` proposes an already-known product (via `product_id`);
`create` inserts/reuses a product from `name`/`brand`/`unit`.

assigned.description: proposals updated (rows stay in the review queue until approved)

created.description: products inserted on the fly during this batch

off_cache.description: Present only when OFF enrichment is enabled.

by_status.description: Request counts keyed by status class (2xx/4xx/5xx/...).

latency_buckets_ms.description: Upper bound of each histogram bin, in milliseconds.

histogram.description: Count per bin; one extra overflow bin at the end.
